prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Turn the supplied SVG massing guide into a warm casual hand-drawn Beijing neighborhood component for a travel-journal map. The guide is a binding layout reference, not a style reference. Keep every building's position, orientation, relative footprint, spacing, and height class. Keep the same image framing and empty margin. Slightly elevated 2.5D planar map angle EXACTLY as guide. Loose confident fountain-pen outlines, small irregularities, opaque watercolor/gouache washes, cream walls, muted coral balcony bands, gray-green roofs, subtle paper grain confined to pigment. Intended displayed width only 200–300 pixels: broad simple strokes, few window/balcony marks, NO fine grids, no tiny railings, no photoreal textures. Beijing ordinary late-20th-century apartments, not European housing, not hutongs. Keep yard pale, just a few restrained green washes. No public roads, cars, people, labels, signs, numerals, compass, frame, border, drop shadow, floating island or solid rectangular background. Exterior fully transparent; sparse soft-edged yard wash inside only. Preserve separation between buildings. Do not add buildings. This is an illustration candidate, not evidence of historic appearance. Exactly THREE compact tall apartment towers and ONE long elevator slab along the lower edge. Do not merge the left two towers. Tower tops may have a tiny muted coral cap, no elaborate pitched roof.
